  InputOTP,

"use client";

import React from "react"

import {
  InputOTP,
  InputOTPGroup,
  InputOTPSeparator,
  InputOTPSlot,
} from "@/components/rendyn-libraries/shadcn/upstream/registry/new-york-v4/ui/input-otp"

export default function InputOTPWithSeparator() {
  return (
    <InputOTP maxLength={6}>
      <InputOTPGroup>
        <InputOTPSlot index={0} />
        <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
      </InputOTPGroup>
      <InputOTPSeparator />
      <InputOTPGroup>
        <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
        <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
      </InputOTPGroup>
      <InputOTPSeparator />
      <InputOTPGroup>
        <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
        <InputOTPSlot index={5} />
      </InputOTPGroup>
    </InputOTP>
  )
}
